info.title: VoidMob Public API
info.summary: SMS verifications, mobile proxies, and webhooks for programmatic use.
info.description:
The VoidMob Public API (`/api/v1`) exposes the same surface that powers the
dashboard - SMS verifications, mobile/GB proxy provisioning, real-time
balance, and outbound webhooks - under a stable, programmatic contract.

Running higher volumes? Custom pricing is available -
[contact us](https://voidmob.com/contact).

## Conventions

- **Base URL:** `https://dashboard.voidmob.com/api/v1`
- **Authentication:** Bearer token. Issue keys from
  [Developers - API Keys](https://dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys).
  Live keys are prefixed `vmk_live_`.
- **Money:** all monetary values are **USD cents** as integers. The API
  never returns floats for money.
- **Identifiers:** every public id has a stable prefix (`svc_`, `ver_`,
  `ren_`, `prx_`, `plan_`, `pool_`, `list_`, `whep_`, `esim_`, `prod_`,
  `evt_`). Treat them as opaque.
- **Envelopes:** every JSON response is either
  `{ "success": true, "data": ... }` or
  `{ "success": false, "error": { code, message, docs_url, request_id, details? } }`.
- **Idempotency:** order-creating and money-moving POST / PATCH / DELETE
  requests require an `Idempotency-Key` header (any string up to 255
  chars) - see each operation's parameters for whether it is required.
  Lighter-weight management calls (webhook-endpoint create/delete,
  auto-renew toggle, dedicated IP rotation) do not. Re-sending the same
  key with the same body replays the original response; a different body
  returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.
- **Rate limits:** every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`,
  `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (unix seconds). 429s
  additionally carry `Retry-After`.
- **Pricing:** SMS prices drift between catalog and create. Send
  `max_price_cents` to cap how much you authorize; if the lowest
  available price is above that cap, the API returns `409 PRICE_OVER_CAP`
  with both your cap and the current price in the error details. No
  partial state is created. See `verifications` and `rentals`.

tags.description: Create, poll, cancel, complete, and reuse SMS verifications.

tags.description: Create and manage long-term phone number rentals (multi-day, multi-SMS).

tags.name: Proxies
tags.description: Buy and manage mobile / shared proxy packages and their lists.

tags.name: Proxy pools
tags.description:
Reseller-only, mobile/GB proxies only. A pool is a block of prepaid GB at a
negotiated per-GB rate, drawn down by the sub-orders you mint for your own
customers (`POST /v1/proxies` with `pool_id`). Pools are not self-serve: one
is provisioned for your account under a separate reseller agreement, so these
endpoints return nothing until you have one. Contact support to set one up.
SMS, dedicated numbers, and eSIM have no pool equivalent - resellers use the
standard endpoints with volume pricing applied to the account.

tags.description: Cascading geo data for mobile proxy targeting.

get.description:
Returns the caller's user id, wallet balance, per-endpoint-group
rate-limit ceilings, and account-created timestamp. Cacheable for 5
seconds with `ETag` / `If-None-Match`.

304.description: Not Modified. Body is empty; reuse the cached value.

get.description:
Reports overall API health, a list of SMS services that have been
degraded for over 15 minutes, and recent proxy provisioning latency.
IP-rate-limited at 10 req/min.

get.summary: Fetch an immutable service icon PNG
get.description:
Returns the PNG icon referenced by `Service.icon_url`. Files are
content-hashed and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` -
cache aggressively.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: 16-char hex content hash, or the literal `default`.

get.summary: List SMS services for a country
get.description:
Returns the SMS service catalog for the requested country with a live
per-caller quote. Cacheable for 30 seconds via
`ETag` / `If-None-Match`.

The `quoted_price_cents` reflects per-caller pricing (account
discounts/overrides). Use it as the safe default for
`max_price_cents` when creating a verification.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on `service_name`.

get.description:
Returns the curated eSIM product catalog with per-caller pricing.
Cacheable for 60 seconds via `ETag` / `If-None-Match`.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

parameters.name: has_calls
parameters.description: Filter to plans that include a phone number and calls (true) or data-only plans (false).

get.summary: Get an eSIM product by id
get.description:
Returns a single eSIM product from the catalog. Hidden products are
treated as non-existent. Cacheable for 60 seconds.

post.summary: Purchase an eSIM (or topup with parent_order_id)

Not found. Body discriminates by `error.code`:

- `PARENT_ORDER_NOT_FOUND` - the `parent_order_id` does not exist or belongs to another user

409.description:

- `TOPUP_INCOMPATIBLE`, `PARENT_ORDER_NOT_ACTIVE`

Returns topup addon products available for the given eSIM's product

post.description:
Convenience endpoint that forwards to `POST /esims` with
`parent_order_id` set to this eSIM's id. The path value takes

201.description: Topup purchased. Returns the new eSIM topup order.

409.description:
Conflicts. Body discriminates by `error.code`:
- `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_IN_FLIGHT`
- `TOPUP_INCOMPATIBLE`, `PARENT_ORDER_NOT_ACTIVE`
- `PRICE_OVER_CAP` - current price exceeds `max_price_cents`; see `PriceOverCapError`

post.summary: Create a verification
post.description:
Rents a phone number for one inbound SMS. Idempotent by
`Idempotency-Key`.

## Caps

SMS pricing drifts. Set `max_price_cents` to opt into "always get a
number" behaviour: any drift up to your cap charges silently and the
actual amount appears as `charged_price_cents` on the response. Omit
`max_price_cents` to lock in exactly the price you saw on
`GET /v1/services`.

## Price over cap

If the lowest available price is above your `max_price_cents`, the API
returns **`409 PRICE_OVER_CAP`** with both values in the error details:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "PRICE_OVER_CAP",
    "details": {
      "max_price_cents": 35,
      "available_price_cents": 42
    }
  }
}
```

No partial state is created and no funds are touched. Decide locally
whether to retry with a higher cap or surface the price to the user.

201.description: Verification created. `status` is always `waiting_for_code` at this point.

409.description:
Conflicts. Body discriminates by `error.code`:
- `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` - same key, different body
- `IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_IN_FLIGHT` - duplicate while original processes
- `PRICE_OVER_CAP` - lowest available price exceeds `max_price_cents`; see `PriceOverCapError`

get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of short-term verifications owned by
the authenticated caller, newest-first. Up to 100 items per page
(default 20). Use `next_cursor` from the response to fetch the next
page. Long-term rentals are not included - use `GET /v1/rentals`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by verification status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

get.description:
Poll the verification's current state. Uses the generous
`verifications_read` rate-limit bucket - safe to poll every few
seconds. Prefer webhooks for production use.

get.summary: List all SMS received on a verification
get.description:
Returns every SMS the number has received, newest first. The number can
receive several distinct codes over its life (the line is auto-reused
during the window), so this is the way to retrieve the full set rather
than just the latest `code` on the verification resource.

Includes ambient SMS with no extractable code (`code: null`). Uses the
generous `verifications_read` rate-limit bucket. Capped at the 200 most
recent messages.

200.description: All messages received on the number, newest first.

post.summary: Cancel a pending verification
post.description:
Cancels a verification that has not yet received a code. The number is
released and the wallet is refunded atomically in the same database
transaction.

Cancellation is only valid while `can_cancel: true` on the
verification. Once a code arrives the call returns
`409 CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED`.

409.description: Idempotency conflict OR the verification can no longer be cancelled.

post.summary: Mark a verification as done
post.description:
Marks a verification as complete and moves it out of the active
dashboard list into history. Local-only status flip - no refund, no
external call, no balance movement. Use this when your integration
has consumed the code and you no longer want the verification taking
up space in the active view.

Valid while the verification is in `waiting_for_code` or
`code_received` state, or when it has expired without a code. Once
explicitly completed (or cancelled), the call returns
`409 COMPLETE_NOT_ALLOWED`.

Completion is optional - verifications automatically leave the
active list when their rental window expires (~15 min). This
endpoint just lets bulk callers tidy up sooner.

409.description: Idempotency conflict OR the verification can no longer be completed.

post.summary: Free reuse of a verification that already received a code
post.description:
Re-arms the same number to receive another SMS while the rental's
window is still open. Free because the original rental still owns the
number.

Callers should check `allow_reuse` on the verification resource before
calling. The rental may have transitioned states between your last GET
and this call - in that case the API returns
`409 REUSE_NOT_ALLOWED`. Per-rental cooldown is 30 seconds.

Reuse is not supported on every catalog service. When unavailable the
API returns `409 NOT_SUPPORTED`; check `allow_reuse` on the verification
first to skip the round trip.

200.description: Reuse successful; the verification resource is re-armed and ready for a new code.

post.summary: Paid reuse of an expired or completed verification
post.description:
Reclaims a number from the available pool by charging a fixed
`paid_reuse_price_cents` (currently 50 = $0.50). The charge happens
atomically; on any failure (number left the pool, eligibility closed)
the wallet is refunded and the call returns `409 REUSE_NOT_ALLOWED`.

You **must** send `accept_charge_cents` in the body matching the
current `paid_reuse_price_cents` - this is an explicit consent guard
against accidental charges. Read the value off the verification
resource instead of hardcoding.

After a paid reuse `allow_paid_reuse` flips to `false`; it re-arms once
the number reaches the next eligible state transition (the reused rental
expires, is confirmed, or receives a message), at which point a further
paid reuse becomes available again - best-effort.

Per-rental cooldown is 30 seconds. LTR rentals must re-rent through
the create endpoint instead.

200.description: Paid reuse successful. `charged_reuse_cents` reflects what was deducted.

post.summary: Create a long-term rental
post.description:
Reserves a dedicated phone number for a fixed duration (3, 7, 14, or 30
days). All incoming SMS messages are collected and accessible via
`GET /v1/rentals/{id}`. Idempotent by `Idempotency-Key`.

## Price over cap

LTR pricing can drift. If the lowest available price exceeds your
`max_price_cents` ceiling at request time, the API returns
**`409 PRICE_OVER_CAP`** with both values in the error details:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "PRICE_OVER_CAP",
    "details": {
      "max_price_cents": 1500,
      "available_price_cents": 1750
    }
  }
}
```

No partial state is created and no funds are touched. Decide locally
whether to retry with a higher cap or surface the price to the user.

## Duration

`duration` must be one of `3D`, `7D`, `14D`, or `30D`. Only
`country="us"` is currently supported.

## Auto-renew

Set `auto_renew: true` to automatically charge the same duration at
expiry. Toggle at any time via `POST /v1/rentals/{id}/auto_renew`.

404.description:
Not found. Body discriminates by `error.code`:
- `SERVICE_NOT_FOUND` - unknown service id
- `LTR_NOT_AVAILABLE` - service does not offer the requested duration
- `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` - `webhook_endpoint_id` is unknown or belongs to another user

409.description:
Conflicts. Body discriminates by `error.code`:
- `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` - same key, different body
- `IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_IN_FLIGHT` - duplicate while original processes
- `PRICE_OVER_CAP` - lowest available price exceeds `max_price_cents`; see `PriceOverCapError`

get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of long-term rentals owned by the
authenticated caller. Results are sorted newest-first. Up to 100 items
per page (default 20). Use `next_cursor` from the response to fetch
the next page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by rental status.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Filter by duration.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

get.summary: Get a long-term rental by id
get.description:
Returns the full rental resource including all received messages. Poll
every few seconds during active rentals; prefer webhooks for production
use.

Use the `messages_limit` and `messages_before` query parameters to page
through older messages when there are many.

parameters.name: messages_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to include.

parameters.name: messages_before
parameters.description: Opaque message cursor. Returns messages older than this id.

200.description: Current state of the rental including messages.

delete.description:
Cancels an active rental and issues a wallet refund. Cancellation is
only available within the first hour after creation (`can_cancel:
true`). Once the cancel window has passed or the rental is no longer
active, the call returns `409 CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED`.

`Idempotency-Key` is required: a network retry on a successful cancel
replays the cached `200` instead of returning `CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED`
against the now-cancelled rental. Reusing the same key for a different
rental returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

On success the rental's `status` transitions to `cancelled` and a
`rental.cancelled` webhook event is dispatched.

409.description:
Conflict. Body discriminates by `error.code`:
- `CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED` - rental is past the cancel window or already terminal
- `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` - same `Idempotency-Key` reused with a different rental id
- `IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_IN_FLIGHT` - original cancel call is still processing; retry after `Retry-After`

post.summary: Re-rent an expired LTR number
post.description:
Purchases a fresh rental period on the same phone number at the current
re-rent price. Only call when `re_rent_available: true` on the rental
resource.

No request body. `Idempotency-Key` is optional but recommended to guard
against network retries triggering a double charge.

### 410 semantics

A `410 RE_RENT_NOT_AVAILABLE` response means the number has been permanently
released. **Stop retrying**; `re_rent_available`
will be `false` on subsequent fetches. Offer the user a fresh rental via
`POST /v1/rentals` instead.

200.description:
Re-rent succeeded. Returns the updated rental resource with the new
`expires_at` and `paid_until`. `status` transitions back to `active`.

410.description:
The number is no longer available for re-rent - it has been
released. `error.code` is `RE_RENT_NOT_AVAILABLE`. Stop retrying
and offer a fresh rental instead.

post.summary: Enable or disable auto-renew on a rental
post.description:
Sets the `auto_renew` flag to an explicit state. Unlike a toggle,
calling with the same `enabled` value twice is safe (idempotent by
construction). No `Idempotency-Key` header is required.

When `enabled: true`, the rental will automatically renew for the same
duration at expiry. When `enabled: false`, the rental expires normally
when `expires_at` is reached.

Returns `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` if the rental has already expired.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Optional on this endpoint. The body is an explicit state setter, so
repeated calls with the same `enabled` value are no-ops at the
backend regardless of this header. Include one if your client
uniformly tags every mutation - it is accepted but not enforced.

200.description: Auto-renew preference updated. Returns the updated rental.

get.description:
Returns active proxy plans with per-user quoted pricing. Plans
without a public id are filtered out.

Without `type`, only mobile/GB (`shared`) plans are returned and the
response has no `next_cursor` (the original response). With `type`,
Standard dedicated plans can be included, plans come back in a stable
order, and `next_cursor` pages through them. Premium dedicated plans
are never listed.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Plan types to list. `all` is shared + Standard dedicated.

parameters.name: min_gb
parameters.description: Filter to plans with at least this many GB included. Any value above 0 excludes dedicated plans.

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: With `type`, `true` returns only plans available right now.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: With `type`, the `next_cursor` from the previous page.

next_cursor.description: Present only when `type` was passed. Null on the last page.

get.description:
One plan - mobile/GB or Standard dedicated - in the same shape as the
list, with your quoted price and, for a Standard plan, its current
availability. Use it to refresh a quote right before buying. Premium,
retired and unknown plans are not found.

404.description: PROXY_PLAN_NOT_FOUND - unknown, retired or Premium plan.

post.summary: Purchase a proxy package
post.description:
Buys a mobile/GB proxy package or a Standard dedicated proxy, either
by `plan_id` (charged to the wallet) or by `pool_id` (a mobile/GB
sub-order drawn from a reseller GB pool the caller owns - see the
`Proxy pools` tag). Provide exactly one of `plan_id` or `pool_id`.
Returns **`202 Accepted`**. A mobile/GB package comes back
`status: provisioning` and becomes active within 1-2 minutes. A
Standard dedicated proxy comes back `active` with its `gateway` when
the modem is issued immediately, otherwise `provisioning` (settled
within about 5 minutes). The `proxy.ready` webhook fires when the
order becomes active; `proxy.provisioning_failed` (with the refund)
if it cannot be provisioned.

For a Standard dedicated plan, nothing is charged unless the plan is
still available: a sold-out plan returns `503 SERVICE_OUT_OF_STOCK`
and a price above `max_price_cents` returns `409 PRICE_MISMATCH`,
both before any charge. Premium dedicated plans are not available
over the API.

Wallet deduction and refund-on-failure are atomic for a `plan_id`
purchase. A `pool_id` purchase never touches the wallet - GB is drawn
from the pool's ledger and returned to it if provisioning fails.

202.description: Proxy purchase accepted. Wait for `proxy.ready` or poll `GET /v1/proxies/:id`.

409.description: Conflict - IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_IN_FLIGHT, PRICE_MISMATCH, PROXY_NOT_READY, POOL_LAPSED, or POOL_INSUFFICIENT_GB.

get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of proxy packages owned by the
authenticated caller. Up to 100 items per page (default 50). Use
`next_cursor` from the response to fetch the next page.

Filters are AND-combined. `status` is repeatable; the others accept a
single value.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by package status. Repeat the param to combine values.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by package type.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: 2-letter ISO country code. Matched against dedicated-proxy country only.

parameters.name: pool_id
parameters.description: Restrict to sub-orders minted from a single GB pool.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` in the next request to advance the page. Null on the last page.

get.summary: Get a proxy package by id

200.description: The proxy package, including gateway creds (if provisioned) and all lists.

get.summary: Live traffic usage for a proxy package
get.description: Returns daily / weekly / monthly / total / remaining byte counters.

post.summary: Re-buy the plan on a package (adds a full plan of GB and one period)
post.description:
Adds one full plan allocation of GB on top of whatever is left and
extends `expires_at` by one plan period (from now if the package had
already lapsed). Accepted on `active`, `exhausted`, and `expired`
packages within 7 days of expiry; the package is `active` afterwards
and the traffic webhooks are re-armed. Charged at the plan's current
price; refunded automatically on failure.

On a pool-backed sub-order (`proxy.pool_id` set), renew instead
re-allocates the sub-order's **original** GB and duration from the
pool - not one plan period - at no incremental wallet charge.
`max_price_cents` is ignored. See the `Proxy pools` tag.

On a Standard dedicated proxy, renew extends an `active` proxy by one
term of its own plan, from the current `expires_at`, at the price it
was bought at with your current discount. `max_price_cents` is
required and checked before charging. An expired dedicated proxy
cannot be renewed (`409 PROXY_EXPIRED`); a Premium one returns
`422 NOT_SUPPORTED`. `proxy.renewed` fires on success.

200.description: Renewed; new `expires_at` reflected on the proxy. `pool_gb_charged` is present when the order is pool-backed.

pool_gb_charged.description: GB drawn from the pool for this renewal. Present only when `proxy.pool_id` is set.

409.description: Conflict - PRICE_MISMATCH (catalog or dedicated), PROXY_EXPIRED / PROXY_NOT_READY, or POOL_LAPSED / POOL_INSUFFICIENT_GB (pool-backed).

post.summary: Turn auto-renew on or off for a Standard dedicated proxy
post.description:
Sets auto-renew to the given state. With auto-renew on, the proxy is
renewed for one more term of its plan about 12 hours before
`expires_at`, charged to your wallet at the same price a manual renew
would charge; `proxy.renewed` fires when it lands. If your balance is
too low it retries until expiry, then the proxy expires and
`proxy.expired` fires.

Setting the current state again is a no-op, so the call is safe to
retry and needs no `Idempotency-Key`. Turning auto-renew on requires
an `active` proxy; turning it off always succeeds. Mobile/GB
packages and Premium dedicated proxies return `422 NOT_SUPPORTED`.

409.description: Conflict - PROXY_EXPIRED or PROXY_NOT_READY (turning auto-renew on).

post.summary: Add GB to a proxy package
post.description:
Prorated from the plan's per-GB price. Accepted on `active`,
`exhausted`, and `expired` packages within 7 days of expiry; a
successful top-up leaves the package `active` and re-arms the
`proxy.traffic_low` / `proxy.traffic_exhausted` webhooks. Expiry grows
in proportion to the GB added, from the current expiry or from now if
the package had lapsed.

On a pool-backed sub-order (`proxy.pool_id` set), the GB is drawn from
the pool instead of the wallet and `max_price_cents` is ignored. See
the `Proxy pools` tag.

Dedicated proxies are unmetered and return `422 NOT_SUPPORTED`.

200.description: GB added; new totals reflected on the proxy. `pool_gb_charged` is present when the order is pool-backed.

pool_gb_charged.description: GB drawn from the pool for this top-up. Present only when `proxy.pool_id` is set.

post.summary: Rotate the package-level gateway password
post.description:
Rotates the Flex mode gateway password. The gateway must have been
initialized via `POST /v1/proxies/:id/flex_credentials` first;
otherwise this returns `409 PROXY_NOT_READY` with a message pointing
at that endpoint.

post.summary: Rotate the proxy's exit IP
post.description:
Triggers an IP rotation for a dedicated proxy. Each call requests a
fresh exit IP; the modem typically reflects the new address within a
few seconds. Subsequent reads of `GET /v1/proxies/{id}` will show
the updated `current_ip` once the rotation lands.

Constraints:
- Only dedicated proxies support this endpoint. Calling it on a
  shared (gb) proxy returns `422 NOT_SUPPORTED`.
- The proxy must be `status: active`, else `409 PROXY_NOT_READY`.
- Hard cooldown of 60 seconds per proxy, independent of the API
  key's rate-limit bucket. Each proxy has its own cooldown bucket -
  rotating proxy A does not block rotating proxy B. Excess calls
  on the same proxy return `429 RATE_LIMITED`.

This endpoint is not idempotent by design; each successful call
produces a different IP. `Idempotency-Key` is not honored.

200.description: Rotation accepted. `current_ip` is best-effort and may be `null` if the modem hasn't reported the new address yet.

current_ip.description: Newly assigned IPv4/IPv6 if known, else null. Poll `GET /v1/proxies/{id}` until populated.

post.summary: Get or create the Flex mode gateway credentials
post.description:
Idempotent get-or-create for the package-level gateway used by Flex
mode. First call provisions the credentials; subsequent calls return
the persisted credentials without additional work.

Requires the package to be `status: active` (else `409 PROXY_NOT_READY`).

Once provisioned, geo / session / rotation are controlled per request
via underscore-prefixed username parameters: `_c_<iso>`, `_sd_<id>`,
`_city_<name>`, `_asn_<n>`, `_zip_<code>`, `_s_<id>`, `_ttl_<duration>`,
`_rotm_<0|1|2>`. See the proxies docs reference for the full parameter
list and chaining rules.

post.summary: Create a per-list configuration on a proxy package
post.description:
Creates a new geo-targeted list under a package. Geo rules:
- `country` (single) **xor** `countries` (array of 2-30) is required.
- `region`, `city`, `isp`, `zip` are only valid with a single `country`.
Violations return `400 PROXY_GEO_CONFLICT`.

Max 100 lists per package by default (higher per-package limits
available on request). The returned `entries[]` and
`credentials.port` are resolved and persisted before the response is
returned.

Pass `network` to authenticate the list by source IP instead of
login/password. `credentials` is then `null` and `entries[]` carries a
bare `host:port`. The whitelist is create-time only and an address can be
whitelisted on one list at a time, so a clash returns
`409 PROXY_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE` - retry with a different address.

409.description: Conflict - PROXY_NOT_READY, PROXY_LIST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, or PROXY_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE (the requested IP whitelist overlaps an address already in use on another list).

patch.description: Partial update. Same geo rules as create.

post.summary: Rotate per-list credentials
Extend a GB pool at its current rate (self-serve)
post.description:
Adds `gb` at the pool's current `price_per_gb_cents` and pushes
`valid_until` forward by `self_extend.adds_days` (from now if the pool
had lapsed). Charged to the wallet. Refused when self-serve extension
is disabled or `gb` is under `self_extend.min_gb`. Works on a lapsed
pool - this is how a reseller reactivates one.

post.summary: Register a webhook subscription
post.description:
Registers an HTTPS URL to receive event deliveries. The response
includes the HMAC-SHA256 `signing_secret` **once** - store it securely;
it cannot be retrieved again. Use it to verify the
`X-VoidMob-Signature` header on every inbound delivery.

`event_types` accepts the literal `"*"` for all events, or any subset
of the typed enum. Max 20 endpoints per user.

201.description: Endpoint registered. `signing_secret` is included exactly once.

200.description: Endpoints owned by the authenticated user.

get.summary: Cascading geo data for mobile proxy targeting
get.description:
Hierarchical geo lookup:

- No params - countries with `available_nodes`
- `?country=X` - regions in that country
- `?country=X&region=Y` - cities in that region
- `?country=X&region=Y&city=Z` - ISPs in that city

Response is public-cacheable for 5 minutes.

200.description: One of countries, regions, cities, or ISPs depending on the parameters.

get.summary: List available dedicated number countries with per-user pricing
get.description:
Returns all enabled dedicated number countries with per-user quoted prices.
The quoted_price_cents reflects any active category discounts for your account.

200.description: List of available dedicated number countries.

quoted_price_cents.description: Per-user price in cents (after any account discounts).

base_price_cents.description: Retail base price in cents before any discounts.

in_stock.description: Whether this country has inventory available right now.

get.description:
Returns all dedicated numbers owned by the authenticated user, including
numbers purchased via the dashboard or the legacy US-only endpoint.
Paginated via keyset cursor on `id` (descending). Pass the returned
`next_cursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. `active` includes `message_received` numbers.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Filter by lowercase ISO-2 country code (e.g. "de").

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous call to paginate to the next page.

charged_price_cents.description: Price actually charged in USD cents.

post.summary: Purchase a dedicated phone number
post.description:
Purchase a dedicated phone number for the specified country. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key` header. If the resolved per-user price exceeds
`max_price_cents`, the server returns `PRICE_OVER_CAP` (409) without
touching your wallet - retry with a fresh key or a higher cap.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key to make this request idempotent.

auto_renew.description: Automatically renew this number at the end of each billing period.

max_price_cents.description:
Optional price ceiling in cents. If the resolved per-user price is above
this value the request returns PRICE_OVER_CAP (409) without charging.
Defaults to the quoted price - effectively no cap.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: Deliver `rental.created` to this endpoint instead of the default.

quoted_price_cents.description: Price quoted at purchase time in USD cents.

charged_price_cents.description: Price actually charged in USD cents.

next_renewal_price_cents.description: Price that will be charged on next renewal in USD cents.

auto_renew.description: Whether this number auto-renews at period end.

paid_until.description: Date through which the number is paid.

messages.description: SMS messages received on this number.

get.summary: Get a dedicated number with its messages
get.description:
Returns a single dedicated number owned by the authenticated user, including
paginated SMS messages received on the number. Use `messages_before` and
`messages_limit` to page through message history (newest-first fetch, returned
in ascending order).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Dedicated number id prefixed `ded_`.

parameters.name: messages_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: messages_before
parameters.description: Cursor for paging older messages. Pass a `msg_<id>` value to retrieve messages before that id.

200.description: Dedicated number detail with inline messages.

charged_price_cents.description: Price actually charged in USD cents.

next_renewal_price_cents.description: Price that will be charged on next renewal in USD cents.

auto_renew.description: Whether this number auto-renews at period end.

paid_until.description: Date through which the number is paid.

messages.description: SMS messages received on this number, in ascending order. Paginate with messages_before cursor.

post.summary: Toggle auto-renew for a dedicated number
post.description:
Sets auto-renew to the specified state for a dedicated number owned by the
authenticated user. Unlike a flip toggle, this is idempotent - calling with
the same `enabled` value twice is safe.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Dedicated number id prefixed `ded_`.

enabled.description: Set to `true` to enable auto-renew, `false` to disable.

200.description: Auto-renew state updated. Returns the updated dedicated number.

quoted_price_cents.description: Price quoted at purchase time in USD cents.

charged_price_cents.description: Price actually charged in USD cents.

next_renewal_price_cents.description: Price that will be charged on next renewal in USD cents.

auto_renew.description: Whether this number auto-renews at period end.

post.summary: Fired when a verification is created via the API.
post.description:
## Signature

Every delivery includes `X-VoidMob-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`.
Compute `v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "${t}.${raw_body}")` and compare in
constant time. Reject if `t` is more than 5 minutes from now to
prevent replay.

## Retries

Failed deliveries (non-2xx, timeout, network) are retried with
exponential backoff for ~24 hours. After 30 consecutive failures the
endpoint is auto-disabled; re-enable it from the developer portal.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Any 2xx is accepted; body is ignored.

post.summary: Fired when an SMS code lands on a verification.
Fired when a verification is cancelled via the API or auto-refunded because no SMS arrived in the window (refund included on payload).
Fired when a verification is explicitly marked complete via POST /verifications/{id}/complete.
Fired when a verification's window closes with no SMS and no automatic refund (non-refundable services and rare exceptions; the usual no-SMS outcome is verification.cancelled with a refund).
Fired when a verification terminally fails after creation. Reserved - not emitted in the current release.
Fired when a long-term rental is created via the API.
Fired once for every new SMS on an API-bought rental or dedicated number, with or without a detected code. A coded message fires this first, then rental.code_received.
Fired when a new SMS with a detected code arrives on an API-bought rental or dedicated number.
Fired when a rental successfully auto-renews.
Fired when a rental expires without renewal.
Fired when a rental is cancelled.
Fired when auto-renew is disabled on a rental (e.g. due to insufficient balance at renewal time).
Fired when a provisioning proxy package becomes active.
Fired when a proxy package fails to provision and the user is refunded.
Fired when a proxy package's duration ends.
Fired once per allocation when usage crosses 90% (10% remaining); a top-up or renew re-arms it.
Fired when remaining traffic reaches zero.
Fired after a successful `POST /v1/proxies/:id/renew`.
Fired once when a pool's remaining_gb drops to or below its low-GB threshold; a successful extension re-arms it.
Fired once, 3 days before a pool's valid_until.
Fired after a successful `POST /v1/proxy_pools/:id/extend`, self-serve or admin-initiated.
Fired when an eSIM order is successfully created and provisioned.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Any 2xx is accepted; body is ignored.

post.summary: Fired when an eSIM order fails to provision and the user is refunded.
Fired when a topup is successfully provisioned on an existing eSIM.
Fired when an eSIM's validity period ends.
Fired when an eSIM order is cancelled.
Fired when an eSIM order is refunded.

bearerAuth.description:
Issue keys from the developer portal. Send as
`Authorization: Bearer vmk_live_xxxxxxxx`. Optional per-key IP
allowlist is enforced server-side.

ProxyListId.description: Identifier for a per-list configuration inside a proxy package.

RequestId.description: Server-assigned identifier for a single request.

amount_cents.description: Wallet balance in USD cents. May be negative momentarily during refunds.

formatted.description: Pre-formatted dollar amount, suitable for direct display.

rate_limits.description:
Per-endpoint-group ceilings for this caller. Keys are the
endpoint groups returned by the rate limiter:
`verifications`, `verifications_read`, `services`, `account`,
`proxies`, `reads`.

since.description: Earliest ISO timestamp at which the degradation was observed.

recent_median_seconds.description: Median provisioning latency (seconds) over the last 15 minutes of API-originated orders.

icon_url.description: Path to an immutable PNG icon (cache forever).

quoted_price_cents.description:
Live per-caller quote. This is what will be charged if the quote
still holds at create time. Differs from `base_price_cents` when
the caller has a category discount or per-service override.

base_price_cents.description: Retail price before any per-user discounts.

price_ceiling_cents.description:
Upper bound on how far `quoted_price_cents` can drift under current
market conditions. Set `max_price_cents` up to this value to absorb
normal market drift without seeing `409 PRICE_OVER_CAP`.

available.description: Whether stock is currently available. Unavailable services are still returned so a UI can grey them out.

ltr_3d_price_cents.description:
Per-user quoted price for a 3-day long-term rental of this service.
`0` means the duration is not available for this service.

ltr_7d_price_cents.description:
Per-user quoted price for a 7-day long-term rental of this service.
`0` means the duration is not available for this service.

ltr_14d_price_cents.description:
Per-user quoted price for a 14-day long-term rental of this service.
`0` means the duration is not available for this service.

ltr_30d_price_cents.description:
Per-user quoted price for a 30-day long-term rental of this service.
`0` means the duration is not available for this service.

VerificationStatus.description: `waiting_for_code` - number is live (up to 15 minutes, see `expires_at`), no SMS yet. `code_received` - at least one SMS arrived. `cancelled` - the price was refunded, either because you cancelled or because the window closed with no SMS (automatic refund). `expired` - the window closed with no SMS and no automatic refund (services marked non-refundable, or rare cases where the refund could not be applied automatically). `failed` is reserved and not emitted.

display_id.description:
Human-readable order identifier for display in dashboards and
receipts (e.g. `SMS7K4P2N`). Null for legacy rentals created before
this field was introduced.

service_id.description: Public service id. Null only for legacy rentals where the cache row was retired.

charged_price_cents.description: Actual amount deducted from the wallet for this verification.

pricing_source.description: Attribution for the charged price. Omitted for legacy rentals. "promo" means a redeemed service-discount code priced this purchase.

can_cancel.description: Whether the rental is currently cancellable. Becomes false once a code arrives or the cancel window closes.

code.description: The received SMS code. Present only when `status = code_received`.

code_received_at.description: When the code arrived. Present only when `status = code_received`.

reuse_counter.description: Number of user-initiated reuses (free or paid) on this number. Starts at 0. Automatic reuses are not counted.

allow_paid_reuse.description: Paid reuse is currently available. STR rentals only.

paid_reuse_price_cents.description: Fixed price for one paid reuse.

charged_reuse_cents.description: Set on the response of a successful POST /reuse/paid. Not present otherwise.

refunded_cents.description: Set on the response of a successful POST /cancel. Not present otherwise.

has_more.description: Whether additional pages exist beyond this one.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` in the next request to advance the page. Null on the last page.

code.description: Parsed OTP code, or null for ambient SMS with no extractable code.

max_price_cents.description:
Optional ceiling. If omitted, the API caps at the current
`quoted_price_cents` reported by `GET /v1/services`. Setting this
above the quote opts into "always get a number" mode - price drift
within the cap charges the new market price; drift above the cap
returns `409 PRICE_OVER_CAP` with the current available price in
the error details so callers can decide whether to retry with a
higher cap.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: If set, scope this verification's webhook events to this endpoint only.

accept_charge_cents.description:
Must equal the current `paid_reuse_price_cents` from the
verification resource. Explicit consent guard against accidental
charges from misrouted requests.

max_price_cents.description: The cap the caller authorized on this request.

available_price_cents.description: Lowest currently available price. Fluctuates with demand and stock.

code.description: Extracted numeric code, if any. Null when the SMS is informational.

RentalWebhookMessage.description: The new SMS that triggered a `rental.message_received` event.

id.description: Opaque message identifier (prefixed `msg_`). Matches the entry in `data.rental.messages`.

text.example: Your account was accessed from a new device.

code.description: Detected OTP / verification code, or null when none was found.

sender.description: Sender name or number when known, otherwise null.

display_id.description:
Human-readable order identifier for display in dashboards and
receipts (e.g. `SMS7K4P2N`). Null for legacy rows.

service_id.description:
Public service id from the catalog. Null only for legacy rows
where the catalog entry was retired.

charged_price_cents.description: Actual amount deducted from the wallet.

pricing_source.description: Attribution for the charged price. Omitted for legacy rows. "promo" means a redeemed service-discount code priced this purchase.

Current re-rent price in USD cents. Non-null only when

ISO 8601 timestamp at which the number was permanently released.

Whether the rental is currently cancellable. True only within the

Timestamp at which the cancel window closes. Null for dedicated

Service to rent a number for. Use a catalog service id from

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2, lowercased. Only `us` is supported.

auto_renew.description: Automatically renew the rental for the same duration at expiry.

max_price_cents.description:
Optional price ceiling. Drift within the cap charges silently;
drift above the cap returns `409 PRICE_OVER_CAP` with the current
available price in the error details so callers can decide whether
to retry with a higher cap. Omit to require an exact match to the
current catalog price.

webhook_endpoint_id.description:
If set, scopes the create-time `rental.created` delivery to this
endpoint only. Later rental events (`code_received`, `renewed`,
`expired`, `cancelled`, `auto_renew_disabled`) still fan out to
every enabled endpoint whose `event_types` match.

has_more.description: Whether additional pages exist beyond this one.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` in the next request to advance the page. Null on the last page.

enabled.description:
`true` to enable auto-renew; `false` to disable. Explicit state
(not a toggle) - calling with the same value twice is safe.

ProxyFormat.description: Saved credential-format preference for the dashboard's list export. API `entries` are always `login:pass@host:port`.

ProxyGateway.description:
Connection details. For a mobile/GB package this is the
package-level Flex gateway: geo, session stickiness, and rotation
are controlled per request via underscore-prefixed parameters
appended to `username` (see the proxies docs reference), and
`username_geo_hint` is present. For an active Standard dedicated
proxy it is the modem's own connection: `username` is used as-is,
`port` is the HTTP port and `socks_port` is present.

username.description:
Mobile/GB: base username. Append parameters per request, e.g.
`<username>_c_US_s_session-1_ttl_5m` for a 5-minute sticky
US session. Dedicated: the proxy username, used as-is.

username_geo_hint.description: Mobile/GB only. Short hint pointing at the parameter syntax. The docs are authoritative.

credentials.description: Gateway credentials. Null for IP-whitelist lists, which authenticate by source IP instead of login/password.

For IP-whitelist lists these are bare `host:port` strings. For SOCKS5, use the same host, port and credentials with a `socks5://` scheme.

network.description: Comma-separated IPv4 addresses/subnets whitelisted for this list, or null for login/password lists. Set when the list is created; immutable afterwards - delete and recreate the list to change it.

activation_note.description: Operational hint to surface to the end user.

display_id.description: Human-facing order reference shown in the dashboard. Quote it in support tickets.

type.description: `shared` is a mobile/GB package; the others are dedicated proxies.

country.description: Lowercase ISO code of a dedicated proxy's location. Null for mobile/GB packages.

carrier.description: Mobile carrier of a dedicated proxy. Null for mobile/GB packages.

plan_id.description: The plan used to purchase. Always `null` for a pool-backed sub-order - see `pool_id`.

pool_id.description: The reseller GB pool this package was minted from, or `null` for a catalog purchase.

charged_price_cents.description: What the purchase charged, after any discount. Renewals and top-ups are not included.

auto_renew.description: Whether the proxy renews itself before `expires_at`. Settable on Standard dedicated proxies via `POST /v1/proxies/{id}/auto_renew`.

next_renewal_price_cents.description:
What a renewal (manual or auto-renew) charges right now, with
your current discount - pass it as `max_price_cents` to
`POST /v1/proxies/{id}/renew`. Null when the proxy cannot be
renewed over the API at the moment (pool sub-order, Premium
dedicated, dedicated not active or its plan no longer sold,
package past its renewal window).

gateway.description:
Connection credentials. Mobile/GB: the Flex gateway, null until
the package is active and `POST /v1/proxies/:id/flex_credentials`
has been called. Standard dedicated: populated while the proxy
is active. Always null for Premium dedicated proxies.

rotation_url.description:
Customer-facing rotation URL for dedicated proxies. A simple GET
request to this URL rotates the exit IP, no auth header needed.
Designed for anti-detect browser tools (AdsPower, GoLogin,
Dolphin) that accept a "rotation URL" field. Null for shared
(gb) proxies. The same 60s per-proxy cooldown applies as
`POST /v1/proxies/:id/rotate_ip`. Regenerable from the
dashboard if leaked.

carrier.description: Standard dedicated plans only. Mobile carrier of the modem.

region.description: Standard dedicated plans only. Region the modem sits in; null if the plan takes any region.

quoted_price_cents.description: Price after your discount - what a purchase charges.

available.description:
Always true for mobile/GB plans. For a Standard dedicated plan,
whether its own region has a modem free right now. Refreshes
every 10 minutes; a purchase re-checks before charging.

total_gb.description: Lifetime GB purchased, including every extension.

allocated_gb.description: GB currently held by live sub-orders.

remaining_gb.description: total_gb minus allocated_gb. Includes frozen GB while lapsed.

price_per_gb_cents.description: Current per-GB rate charged on every self-serve extension. Set with you when the pool is provisioned; renegotiated rates apply to later extensions only.

enabled.description: Whether POST /v1/proxy_pools/{id}/extend is allowed self-serve on this pool.

min_gb.description: Minimum gb accepted per self-serve extension.

adds_days.description: Days added to valid_until per extension.

CreateProxyRequest.description: Provide exactly one of `plan_id` (catalog purchase) or `pool_id` (mint from a reseller GB pool).

max_price_cents.description: Required for a catalog (plan-backed) package; ignored for a pool-backed sub-order, where GB is drawn from the pool instead.
Required for a catalog (plan-backed) package; ignored for a pool-backed sub-order, where GB is drawn from the pool instead.

CreateProxyListRequest.description:
Exactly one of `country` or `countries` is required.
`rotation_period_seconds`, `rotation_mode`, and `format` default when
omitted.

The list then authenticates by source IP and returns `credentials: null`. Set at creation only - it cannot be changed on an existing list. An address can be whitelisted on one list at a time; a clash returns 409 PROXY_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE.

signing_secret.description:
The HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for this endpoint. Returned
**once** on creation and never again. Store it securely. Used
to verify the `X-VoidMob-Signature` header on inbound webhook
deliveries.

phone_number_prefix.description: Dial code and country of the phone number included with the plan, e.g. "+44 (United Kingdom)". Null for data-only plans.

call_minutes.description: Included call minutes. Null when calls are unlimited, when the plan has no calls, or when the allowance is not published.

with `smdp_address` to form the full LPA URI: `LPA:1$<smdp_address>$<activation_code>`.

URL to a PNG image of the activation QR code. Null for topups and
orders that have not completed. Cache aggressively - this URL is

data_limit_gb.description: Data allowance in GB. Null when `data_unlimited` is true.

data_unlimited.description: Whether this plan includes unlimited data.

validity_days.description: Plan validity in days from activation.

countries.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (uppercase) where the plan is usable.

routing_location.description: Network routing hint for this eSIM (e.g. country where its data egresses). Informational only.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the eSIM was fully provisioned. Null until status is `completed`.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the eSIM plan expires. Null until the eSIM is activated.

product_id.description: Public product id (prefixed `prod_`) from the eSIM catalog.

Optional price ceiling in USD cents. If the current price exceeds
this value the call returns `409 PRICE_OVER_CAP`. Omit to
accept any price.

Public id of the eSIM to top up (prefixed `esim_`). Any order on

parameter takes precedence.

PublicErrorCode.description: Stable enum of all public error codes. Each code maps to a fixed HTTP status; see the per-response components for status/body shape.

message.description: User-safe human-readable message. Never leaks internals.

docs_url.description: Deep link to the docs anchor for this error code.

request_id.description: Server-assigned identifier for this request. Quote in support tickets.

details.description: Optional structured payload. Present for PRICE_OVER_CAP (available_price_cents, max_price_cents), VALIDATION_ERROR (issues[]), and PROXY_GEO_CONFLICT (issues[]).

id.description: Unique delivery id. Use for deduping on your side.

display_id.description: Human-facing order reference shown in the dashboard. Quote it in support tickets.

refunded_cents.description: Present on `proxy.provisioning_failed` - the amount auto-refunded, in USD cents.

remaining_bytes.description: Present on `proxy.traffic_low` - traffic left when the threshold fired.

remaining_gb.description: Pool's remaining_gb at the moment this event fired.

added_gb.description: Present on `proxy_pool.extended` - GB added by this extension.

charged_price_cents.description: Present on `proxy_pool.extended` - the wallet charge for this extension.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current rate-limit window for this endpoint group.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the current rate-limit window resets.

Retry-After.description:
Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying. Present on
429 responses and on 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_IN_FLIGHT.

ETag.description: Weak entity tag for cacheable GET responses. Use with `If-None-Match` for cheap polling.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Client-supplied key (any string, up to 255 chars) that scopes idempotent
replay for write requests. Required on every POST, PATCH, and DELETE.
Replays with the same key + same body return the cached response;
same key with a different body returns `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Headers
are case-insensitive; both `Idempotency-Key` and `idempotency-key` work.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description:
Pass the most recent `ETag` to get `304 Not Modified` when the
underlying resource has not changed. Cheap-poll friendly.

CountryQuery.name: country
CountryQuery.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, lowercased. Defaults to `us` for SMS endpoints.
